in_sanskrit.name: कालप
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The Sanskrit word 'Kalap' is derived from the root 'Kr' and the suffix 'Alap'. The root 'Kr' means 'time' and the suffix 'Alap' means 'beginning' or 'start'. Therefore, the meaning of 'Kalap' is 'time, moment' or 'the beginning of time'.

in_hindi.name: कालप
in_hindi.long_meaning: The Hindi word for 'Kalap' is 'समय' (Samay), which has the same meaning as the Sanskrit word - 'time' or 'moment'.

in_tamil.name: காலப்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The Tamil word for 'Kalap' is 'காலம்' (Kalam), which means 'time'.

in_telugu.name: కాలప్
in_telugu.long_meaning: The Telugu word for 'Kalap' is 'సమయము' (Samayamu), which means 'time'.

in_marathi.name: Kalap
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kalap हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Kalap refers to the god of time and creation, responsible for the cyclical nature of the universe. The name is derived from the Sanskrit root 'kal' meaning 'time'.
